subject.title: Automatic git worktree management for agent tasks

question: Should OpenClaw adopt managed git worktrees as a core agent-task lifecycle service through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535, or narrow/defer the feature into a smaller plugin/API design?
rationale: The feature aligns with agent-harness and CLI/web ergonomics goals, but it creates new core lifecycle, state, protocol, SDK, UI, and security-sensitive hook surfaces that automation should not decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review the linked core PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide it through normal maintainer review after its blockers are addressed.

options.title: Narrow the scope first
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a staged design that separates core service, Workboard materialization, UI, and plugin SDK exposure.

options.title: Defer core ownership
options.body: Pause or close the linked PR if maintainers decide managed worktrees should live outside core or behind a different extension API first.

recommendation.title: Review the linked core PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide it through normal maintainer review after its blockers are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current Workboard workspace and dispatcher history most directly and authored the linked implementation candidate.
